name: @penguinharness/skilladam-rsi-toolkit
description: SkillAdam RSI Toolkit: organize benchmark experiments and evolve a target Skill through trajectory feedback, an evolving issue tracker, paired evaluation and a variance-controlled edit budget.

penguin.description_zh: SkillAdam RSI 工具包：组织 benchmark 实验，结合执行轨迹、持续更新的问题记录、配对评测和按方差调整的编辑预算，迭代优化目标 Agent 的技能。
penguin.short_description: SkillAdam RSI Toolkit: evolve a Skill from execution feedback.
penguin.short_description_zh: SkillAdam RSI 工具包：根据执行反馈迭代技能。

quick_start.prompt: Read skilladam-rsi-toolkit and run a SkillAdam experiment on the selected benchmark with the requested model and budget.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 读取 skilladam-rsi-toolkit，按指定模型和预算，在选定的 benchmark 上完成 SkillAdam 实验。
